# 7. References

*This section will contain the bibliography generated by Zotero.*

---

## Citation Management Instructions

### Setup (per 13-RESEARCH.md)

1. Install Zotero from zotero.org
2. Install Zotero Connector browser extension
3. Install Chicago 18th edition (note) style:
   - Zotero > Edit > Settings > Cite > Get additional styles
   - Search: "Chicago Manual of Style 18th edition (note)"
4. Create library: "BASTION Whitepaper"

### Adding Sources

- Use Zotero Connector to capture sources from web
- Manually add sources not available online
- Fill all required fields (author, title, date, publisher/journal)

## Generating Bibliography

1. Place cursor at end of References section in Word
2. Zotero > Add/Edit Bibliography
3. Select all sources used in paper
4. Style will auto-format to Chicago 18th (note)

**Note:** All [CITATION NEEDED] placeholders in the document must be replaced with proper footnotes before final submission. Use the following workflow:

1. Search for `[CITATION NEEDED]` across all whitepaper sections
2. For each placeholder, identify the claim requiring citation
3. Find appropriate source in Zotero library (or add new source)
4. Replace placeholder with Zotero citation (footnote format)
5. Verify bibliography updates automatically
